summary: Accepted and completed the positive beneficiary relationship from precision biology and healthcare automation to Recursion Pharmaceuticals with high sensitivity and low confidence. Computational discovery, biological data, automated experimentation, and platform-derived programs create a direct causal exposure, but current primary evidence establishes only early clinical activity, not improved clinical success or durable economics. Immaterial revenue, operating losses, likely financing, dilution, and unsupported valuation remain explicit limits, so no strategy or follow-up operation was created.

evidence.claim: Recursion's SEC-filed Q1 2026 Form 10-Q reports USD 654.5 million of cash and cash equivalents, 530.6 million shares outstanding, a USD 117.5 million quarterly net loss, and an expectation that additional capital will be required to advance drug candidates. The filing supports a direct but financially conditional precision-biology relationship and makes funding and dilution central to shareholder transmission.

The maintained security review records platform-to-clinic activity in REC-1245, REC-4881, and REC-4539, while explicitly distinguishing those milestones from approval, comparative efficacy, commercial value, or an improved portfolio-wide probability of success. It retains low-confidence watching with a valuation_unsupported hard blocker.

The maintained idea defines the causal mechanism through faster candidate search, assays, diagnostics, laboratory automation, and clinical workflows, but requires validated outcomes, recurring economics, regulatory and reimbursement support, and cash conversion before treating workflow progress as investable value.
